headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.1-modder.3
summary: Swipe between launcher tabs with a smooth directional slide — horizontal for top and bottom navbars, vertical for side navbars.

items.text: New swipe gesture: fling toward a neighbouring tab to switch pages with a smooth directional slide animation; horizontal swipes for top and bottom navbars, vertical swipes for left and right side navbars.
The gesture skips scrollable lists moving toward the swipe and text fields, so it never fights normal scrolling, and it can be turned off in Settings → Personalize.
